description:
[Dagger] A basic iron dagger.  Not much, but can't
beat the price.
name: Iron Dagger

description:
[Dagger] A razor-sharp steel dagger.  Basic, but
painful in the right hands.
name: Steel Dagger

description:
[Dagger] A razor-sharp dagger that is enchanted to
bear flames along it's blade for fire damage.
name: Fire Dagger

description:
[Dagger] A razor-sharp dagger that is enchanted to
cut and stab with magical super-cold ice for bite.
name: Ice Dagger

description:
[Dagger] A razor-sharp dagger that is enchanted to
cut and stab with electrical discharge to burn.
name: Lightning Dagger

description: [Dagger] This dagger is enchanted for extra bite.
name: Silver Dagger

description:
[Dagger] With a blade crafted from gemstone, this
dagger is enchanted for military and battle.
name: War Dagger

description:
[Dagger] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Dagger

description:
[Dagger] Forged from bone and shamanic ritual, this
weapon is surprisingly sharp, and double-edged.
name: Tribal Dagger

description:
[Sword] A long-bladed iron longsword made for battle.
Basic, but one of the better among basic weapons.
name: Iron Long Sword

description:
[Sword] A long-bladed steel longsword.  Nice and nifty,
sharp and deadly.  Mundane, but well-forged.
name: Steel Long Sword

description:
[Sword] A razor-sharp sword that is enchanted to
bear flames along it's blade for fire damage.
name: Fire Sword

description:
[Sword] A razor-sharp sword with a blade that cuts
with freezing magic ice.
name: Ice Sword

description:
[Sword] This sword cuts with electric shock to it.  It
does not stun, but electrifies.
name: Lightning Sword

description:
[Sword] Has an enchanted silver blade that is good for
whacking heads and punishing bad guys a lesson.
name: Silver Long Sword

description: [Sword] Forged to deal death.  Enough said.
name: Warlord's Long Sword

description:
[Sword] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Sword

description:
[Sword] This Asian weapon is not a longsword, but a
sword nonetheless, and no joke at it.
name: Katana

description:
[Flail] A spiked ball connected to a chain and then a
handle.  Hurts.  Its supposed to, though.  Iron.
name: Iron Morning Star

description:
[Flail] A spiked ball connected to a chain and then a
handle.  This one has steel spikes, razor sharp.
name: Steel Flail

description:
[Flail] A spiked ball connected to a chain and then a
handle.  Enchanted with magic fire-inflicting abilty.
name: Flail of Fire

description:
[Flail] A spiked ball connected to a chain and then a
handle.  Enchanted with magic ice-inflicting abilty.
name: Flail of Ice

description:
[Flail] A spiked ball connected to a chain and then a
handle.  Enchanted with magic electrical abilty.
name: Flail of Lightning

description:
[Flail] A spiked ball connected to a chain and then a
handle.  Forged with enchanted silver.
name: Silver Flail

description:
[Flail] This military flail is forged with enchanted
gemstone.
name: War Flail

description:
[Flail] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Flail

description:
[Club] If you want a big stick to walk around with,
this is it.  There are better weapons though.  Wood.
name: Wooden Club

description:
[Club] A big bat for whacking bad guys, and this
sucker is made of iron metal, oh yeah!
name: Iron Club

description:
[Club] A steel killing bat.  Don't crush poor baseballs
with it.  Has studs to punish one a lesson better.
name: Steel Club

description: [Club] Enchanted with magical fire for extra bite.
name: Fire Club

description: [Club] Enchanted with magical ice for extra bite.
name: Ice Club

description:
[Club] Enchanted with magical electricity for extra
bite.
name: Lightning Club

description: [Club] Made with enchanted silver.
name: Silver Club

description: [Club] Made with enchanted gemstone.
name: War Club

description:
[Club] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Club

description: [Axe] This axe is made for chopping wood, not battle.
name: Wood Axe

description: [Axe] A one-handed combat axe.  Iron-bladed.
name: Iron Hand Axe

description: [Axe] A one-handed steel battle axe.  Very sharp.
name: Steel Battle Axe

description:
[Axe] A battle axe with an enchanted blade that cuts
with fire.
name: Fire Axe

description:
[Axe] A battle axe with an enchanted blade that cuts
with ice.
name: Ice Axe

description:
[Axe] A battle axe with an enchanted blade that cuts
with electricity.
name: Lightning Axe

description: [Axe] A one-handed steel battle axe.  Very sharp.
name: Silver Axe

description:
[Axe] A two-handed battle axe made with enchanted
gemstone.
name: War Axe

description:
[Axe] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Axe

description:
[Whip] Simple, basic.  Can sometimes tie up an enemy
by coiling around them, just like any whip.
name: Whip

description:
[Whip] Knotted for inflicting more hurt.  The knots
have small, sharp spikes installed.
name: Knotted Whip

description: [Whip] Has rows of sharp iron spikes that cut and hurt.
name: Spiked (Iron) Whip

description:
[Whip] Has rows of sharp steel spikes.  Superior to the
version with iron spikes.
name: Spiked (Steel) Whip

description:
[Whip] Like other whips, coils around targets to keep
them from doing anything, but does fire damage.
name: Fire Whip

description:
[Whip] Like other whips, coils around targets to keep
them from doing anything, but does ice damage.
name: Ice Whip

description:
[Whip] Like other whips, coils around targets to keep
them from doing anything, but does electricity damage.
name: Lightning Whip

description: [Whip] Made with enchanted silver.
name: Silver Whip

description: [Whip] Made with enchanted gemstone.
name: War Whip

description:
[Whip] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Whip

description:
[Staff] Simplicity.  Still an enchanted staff though,
even though it has no special extra powers.
name: Wooden Rune Staff

description:
[Staff] Made out of a nickel-silver enchanted alloy.
Also has runes that magic-users know what to do with.
name: Nickel-Silver Staff

description:
[Staff] Made out of sandstone and steel, and not a bit
of wood.  Surprisingly not too heavy, and very durable.
name: Sandstone Staff

description: [Staff] Enchanted to do fire damage.
name: Fire Staff

description: [Staff] Enchanted to do ice damage.
name: Ice Staff

description: [Staff] Enchanted to do electrical damage.
name: Lightning Staff

description: [Staff] Made with enchanted silver.
name: Silver Staff

description: [Staff] Made with enchanted gemstone.
name: War Staff

description:
[Staff] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Staff

description:
[Bow] A very ordinary, common longbow, made of wood of
course.  YAWN.  Uses agility and attack for damage.
name: Plain Longbow

description:
[Bow] A longbow with a superior design, made of
multiple pieces of wood.
name: Composite Longbow

description:
[Bow] This longbow is a high-end work of art, and the
best non-magical wooden one money can buy.
name: Well-Crafted Longbow

description: [Bow] Enchanted to do fire damage.
name: Fire Longbow

description: [Bow] Enchanted to do ice damage.
name: Ice Longbow

description: [Bow] Enchanted to do electrical damage.
name: Lightning Longbow

description: [Bow] made partly out of enchanted silver.
name: Silver Longbow

description: [Bow] made partly out of enchanted gemstone.
name: War Longbow

description:
[Bow] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Longbow

description:
[Crossbow] A typical crossbow, made mostly out of
wood.  Slower than a longbow but has more punch.
name: Plain Crossbow

description:
[Crossbow] A finely-made crossbow, made mostly out of
wood.  Slower but more damaging than a longbow.
name: Fine Crossbow

description:
[Crossbow] A terrific crossbow.  Anything better is
magical.
name: Well-Crafted Crossbow

description: [Crossbow] Enchanted to hurt with magic fire.
name: Fire Crossbow

description: [Crossbow] Enchanted to hurt with magic ice.
name: Ice Crossbow

description: [Crossbow] Enchanted to hurt with magic lightning.
name: Lightning Crossbow

description:
[Crossbow] A magic crossbow made partially out of
enchanted silver.
name: Silver Crossbow

description:
[Crossbow] A magic crossbow made partially out of
enchanted gemstone.
name: War Crossbow

description:
[Crossbow] Molded from magic clay, and hardened by an
enchanted flame-using process.
name: Clay Crossbow
